properties.name: pqs:context

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl@1.0.3 is a direct dependency of @solana/web3.js@1.34.0 (package-lock.json:2397) and is the app's Ed25519 engine: web3.Keypair.generate() at app/src/api/send-tweet.js:7 generates the per-tweet account keypair (nacl.sign.keyPair) and web3.js signs/verifies every transaction with it — a live use chain, reported separately as a finding. Quantum-vulnerable (Shor), but the Ed25519 signature scheme is fixed by the Solana protocol, so replacement is a chain/protocol migration, not a repo param

Quantum-unsafe signature primitive. No direct ECDSA call in app/src; the primitive is available in the shipped library. Library-level view of the same dep is LIB-a0bfbc1a (elliptic, shard 2).
